title: Shaunki Sardar
description: Three men bound by passion for fine dressing, adventure, and an unshakable moral code. Shamsher becomes a dreaded encounter specialist, while Karan, known for his fiery temper, never backs down from a fight. When Jagir returns from jail, he finds his protégés have grown into his equals, and as they navigate their entangled past, they must forge a new identity-one that comes at a cost paid in emotions, blood, and life.
